hero.filename: Miles M.25 Martinet TT MkI in flight.jpg
hero.caption: A Royal Air Force Miles Martinet TT Mark I (serial HN862) in flight. Following service with The RAE and the Aeroplane and Armament Experimental Establishment, HN862 joined No. 1634 (Anti-Aircraft Cooperation) Flight at Hutton Cranswick, Yorkshire (UK), where it was lost as a result of a forced landing on 7 July 1943.
